# Health in Education Association (Hieda)

> Hieda champions health and wellbeing education in UK schools and workplaces through professional training, membership, and advisory services.

The Health in Education Association (Hieda) is a UK-based organization dedicated to advancing health and wellbeing standards in educational settings. It provides CPD training, professional membership, consultancy services, and maintains quality standards through initiatives like the Seacole Standard framework and Certified Supplier Scheme.

## Key Topics

- Health and Wellbeing Education
- CPD Training & Events
- Professional Membership
- School Health Services
- Clinical Supervision
- First Aid Training
- Mental Health Support
- Safeguarding
- Medical Training
- Consultancy Services
- Accredited Courses
- Health Centre Standards
- Professional Development
- UK Education Sector

## Membership & Access

- [Membership](https://www.hieda.org.uk/membership): Membership information for organizations and individuals in UK health and wellbeing sectors.
- [Membership Fees](https://www.hieda.org.uk/membership/membership-fees): Membership fee structure and pricing tiers for professional and organizational memberships.
- [Member Login](https://www.hieda.org.uk/members): Member login portal for accessing Hieda member area and exclusive resources.

## CPD Training & Professional Development

- [CPD & Events](https://www.hieda.org.uk/cpd-events): CPD events and training programs covering first aid, mental health, and medical conditions.
- [Accredited Training](https://www.hieda.org.uk/accredited-training): Accredited professional development and certificate courses for school nurses and staff.
- [Bespoke Training](https://www.hieda.org.uk/cpd-events/bespoke-training): Bespoke training courses including First Aid at Work and paediatric first aid certification.
- [Clinical Supervision](https://www.hieda.org.uk/cpd-events/clinical-supervision): Clinical supervision services providing reflective support for clinicians and nurses.
- [Event Recordings Archive](https://www.hieda.org.uk/cpd-events/event-recordings-archive): Archive of recorded training sessions available for on-demand access to CPD content.

## Consultancy & Quality Standards

- [Consultancy Services](https://www.hieda.org.uk/cpd-events/consultancy): Consultancy services including health centre audits, wellbeing training, and policy reviews.
- [The Seacole Standard](https://www.hieda.org.uk/the-seacole-standard): Seacole Standard framework for assessing school health centres on treatment and care quality.
- [Hieda Certified Supplier Scheme](https://www.hieda.org.uk/about-us/hieda-certified-supplier-scheme): Directory of Hieda Certified Suppliers demonstrating commitment to health and wellbeing services.

## About Hieda

- [About Us](https://www.hieda.org.uk/about-us): Overview of Hieda's mission to provide health and wellbeing training and support.
- [Meet the Team](https://www.hieda.org.uk/about-us/team): Staff directory introducing Hieda team members including Jess McArdle and Bethan Hudson.
- [Health and Wellbeing Advisory Board](https://www.hieda.org.uk/about-us/hewab): Health and Wellbeing Advisory Board (HEWAB) featuring voluntary professionals passionate about health education.
- [Inclusion & Diversity](https://www.hieda.org.uk/about-us/inclusion-diversity): Hieda's commitment to fostering inclusive, anti-discriminatory culture valuing diversity.

## Careers & Opportunities

- [Job Board](https://www.hieda.org.uk/job-board): Job board listing healthcare careers and medical positions in education and health sectors.

## Support & Contact

- [Contact Us](https://www.hieda.org.uk/contact-us): Contact page for reaching Hieda with inquiries and support from nurse advisors.
- [Testimonials](https://www.hieda.org.uk/cpd-events/testimonials): Member and delegate feedback and reviews of Hieda courses and training programs.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.hieda.org.uk): Homepage for Health in Education Association (Hieda), championing health and wellbeing education in schools and workplaces.
